# BikepackPilot

> Offline web app for planning self-supported bikepacking trips: splits a route into 50 km segments, adjusts for surface, heat, wind and rain, calculates realistic riding days, adapts the gear list and finds water, food, repair and lodging nearby.

## Route plans

- [Camino Francés by Bike](https://bikepackpilot.com/routes/camino-frances-by-bike/): 769 km, Saint-Jean-Pied-de-Port, France → Santiago de Compostela, Spain
- [Danube Cycle Path – Passau to Vienna](https://bikepackpilot.com/routes/danube-cycle-path-passau-vienna/): 333 km, Passau, Germany → Vienna, Austria
- [EuroVelo 6 – Atlantic to Black Sea (The Rivers Route)](https://bikepackpilot.com/routes/eurovelo-6-atlantic-black-sea/): 4,700 km, Nantes / Saint-Brevin-les-Pins, France (Atlantic coast) → Constanța, Romania (Black Sea)
- [EuroVelo 9 – The Amber Route](https://bikepackpilot.com/routes/eurovelo-9-amber-route/): 1,930 km, Gdańsk, Poland → Pula, Croatia
- [Green Velo – Eastern Cycling Trail](https://bikepackpilot.com/routes/green-velo-eastern-poland/): 1,981 km, Elbląg, Poland → Końskie, Poland
- [Hebridean Way Cycling Route](https://bikepackpilot.com/routes/hebridean-way-cycling/): 297 km, Vatersay, Outer Hebrides → Butt of Lewis, Outer Hebrides
- [Tour Divide – Great Divide Mountain Bike Route](https://bikepackpilot.com/routes/tour-divide-great-divide-route/): 4,425 km, Banff, Alberta, Canada → Antelope Wells, New Mexico, USA
